English.Char_Desc_80: Ultra-sharp Windows icon builder down to 16x16 with batch & shape masks.
English.Char_Desc_250: PinSharp ICO is an ultra-sharp Windows icon builder. Drag-and-drop images to build crisp 16x16 to 256px ICO files with zero-halo clamping. Free Edition supports PNG. Pro Edition adds JPEG/BMP/WebP, batch folder conversion, shape masks, and CLI.
English.Char_Desc_450: PinSharp ICO is an ultra-sharp Windows icon builder that solves blur and contrast loss in micro-downscaling. Free Edition creates crisp multi-size ICO files (16 to 256px) from PNG with zero-halo clamping. Pro Edition adds JPEG, BMP, and WebP support, batch multi-file & recursive folder conversion, modern shape masks (Square, Rounded, Circle), output routing, and headless CLI automation. Standalone Native AOT portable app with no runtime needed.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
PinSharp ICO is an ultra-sharp Windows icon (.ico) builder designed for extreme downscaling clarity from 256px down to 16px.
Standard downscaling tools frequently introduce artifacts: white outlines fade into gray, tight dark slits vanish, and edges blur at 16x16 or 24x24. PinSharp ICO tackles this extreme compression through a dedicated edge-preserving engine, maintaining crisp contrast for fine borders, typography, and narrow gaps.
Key Features: 1. Ultra-Sharp Micro-Downscaling Retains high contrast for delicate outlines and narrow slits without muddy halos.
2. Automated Instant Saving on Drag-and-Drop Drop an image (or folder in Pro) into the window. Processing starts instantly, saving the finished .ico automatically.
3. All 11 Standard Windows Sizes Supports 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 72, 96, 128, and 256 px. Switch with presets (All, Standard, Compact) in one click.
4. Modern Shape Masks (Pro Edition) Clip icons into modern Rounded corners or circular shapes with anti-aliasing. Non-square photos are automatically centered.
5. Expanded Formats & Batch Conversion (Pro Edition) Directly converts JPEG, BMP, WebP alongside PNG. Drop multiple images or entire directories to convert recursively.
6. Flexible Output Destinations (Pro Edition) Save next to source, auto-create an 'icons/' subfolder, or choose a custom folder. Auto-numbering prevents overwrites.
7. Headless Command Line Interface (Pro Edition) Run batch icon generation directly from Command Prompt, PowerShell, or local build scripts.
8. Native AOT Compilation & Portability Standalone portable app built with .NET 10 Native AOT. Zero registry impact and no runtime installation required.
Editions: - Free Edition: 100% free for personal & commercial use (PNG input, 1 file at a time, square shape). - Pro Edition: One-time purchase lifetime license (JPEG/BMP/WebP, batch & folders, shape masks, CLI).
